Scope: fact-check of policy/proposals/method-acceptance-draft.md. No repository file was changed. I ran python3 -I -B scripts and read tools. I did not run evaluate.py --check.

## Verified facts
- sha256 of benchmark/preparation.json is 25cf0059164b7ec7d3be88f0bca00dbb16ccac85a82c0f8b28d5b6a7a31c1d35. This matches the draft.
- git rev-parse 0222240d…:benchmark and HEAD:benchmark are both ea0e4c6c1c10ff504d29cfe27ac81a3936a138d5. For :docs both are ff70af76c1a2af732f1f69250ed4d323e92c8fa9. I took HEAD as current main.
- Change-case pins (README.md, typedef-impact.spec.json, diagram-difference.spec.json) are in the `tasks` milestone of preparation.json.
- Precision pins (precision/README.md, plan.json, scripts/precision_plan.py) are in the `baseline` milestone.
- preparation-status.json labels: tasks `reviewed`, baseline `design-reviewed`.
- benchmark/native/job is not in preparation.json. The exclusion sentence is correct.
- benchmark/precision/plan.json:42-43 gives confidence 0.95, seed 40502, count 10000. This matches step 4.
- preparation-status.json:17 (limitations) supports: 23 native slots unresolved, zero native executions, #169 not ready, native answers unavailable, no allocation, #268 store not ready, quota an owner decision, independently_reviewed false, #347 same family as its author, #369 cross-family to #364.
- docs/research/0002-delivery.md:105-109 and :123 give 33–99 and 89–264. Endpoint differences 56 and 165 are correct. Line 153 gives 413 of 415.
- All draft sentences have at most 25 words (script). No gap is hidden. The draft claims no readiness, threshold, goal gate, product claim or fallback.

## Corrections
1. Step 6, #421 overstates cross-family checking. The status says cross-family "to the #418 fix author only". Fix #412 and review #421 are both Codex GPT.
   - old: `Reviews #369 and #421 checked fixes across model families.`
   - new: `Review #369 checked a fix across model families. Review #421 checked the #418 fix across model families. Review #421 checked the #412 fix within one family.`
2. Step 6, "two checker lines" has no support. preparation-status.json:17 says a coordinated removal of the rejecting-control count check is not detected (#421 finding 4).
   - old: `Review #421 found that a coordinated edit of two checker lines can bypass the reason controls.`
   - new: `Review #421 found that a coordinated removal of the rejecting-control count check is not detected.`
3. Step 7 cites an unrelated line. Line 143 is the LVSR/vers mismatch, which the draft does not use.
   - old: `docs/research/0002-delivery.md:105–109,123,143,153–163`
   - new: `docs/research/0002-delivery.md:105–109,123,153`
4. Term consistency. "work change" is not defined elsewhere in the draft.
   - old: `Each work change still requires the applicable owner decision.`
   - new: `Each edit or build still requires your explicit grant.`

## Unverified
- `#379` in step 2 does not appear in preparation-status.json or in the benchmark, docs or policy trees at HEAD. Keep "pending #379" only if the Policymaker cites a source. Otherwise use: `Store readiness evidence remains not ready under capability #268.`
- "lineage level" (step 4) and "Semantic documentation is not pinned by version, location and content hash" (step 5) were not checked against plan.json or the status text within budget.
- Review #415 (verdict revise) has no sentence in preparation-status.json. The draft header cites it as a source for steps 3 and 4. Do not treat it as a limitation source.
- Specification reviews #408 and #409 are the same model family as their authors (GPT).

No changes to merge.
